name: Example
author: Your name
description: A placeholder from hassmic's plugin template: it counts its starts and greets a server you name now and then, and at once when the action button is held a second. Rename it and make it yours.

settings.name: greeting
settings.label: Greeting
settings.help: The word it sends, followed by this Echo's name and how often it has started.

settings.name: protocol
settings.label: Protocol
settings.help: UDP: one datagram a greeting. TCP: one line a greeting, on a connection it keeps.

settings.name: verbose
settings.label: Log every greeting
settings.help: Each greeting as a line in the Echo's log. Only 50 lines a minute are kept.

settings.name: server
settings.label: Server
settings.help: A name or an address. Nothing is sent until you enter one.
